pages.lesson:
LESSON: WORD READING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Word Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Word Reading. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Word Reading and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Word Reading with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Word Reading.
2. Explain Word Reading to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Word Reading.
4. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Word Reading. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Word Reading important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Word Reading is important in everyday life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
